title: Patch: rename the Tipsy keyword to Woozy
notes: Issue #5181 (R5181000): the Stinkyscape+ keyword Tipsy X is renamed Woozy X (Chinese 晕乎 for 微醺), the name alone: the counter, its decay, the stamp and the blur stay R3548000's and R3548001's. C+ #65.1 Rotten Grape, S+ #6.1 Fine Fermented Grape and S+ T-AI-1 Hallucinated Kiwi print Woozy. The shipped snapshots keep printing Tipsy, which reads as Woozy, and what a game writes keeps the old name (the state's and the views' `tipsy` keys, `tipsyBlur`, the counter kind `tipsy`, the blur's seed stream), so a game filed before the rename replays to the hash, the views and the blur it was filed with, and no card plays differently.

player.title: Tipsy is now Woozy
text: Tipsy is renamed Woozy. It works exactly as before: the counter, how it drops each turn and the blurred words are unchanged.
Rotten Grape, Fine Fermented Grape and Hallucinated Kiwi now say Woozy.
